observations.seen: The Crown Arena (frames 1 and 3) is lit by an even warm red-orange wash with no visible 60° top spotlight pooling on the fighters and no rim light separating them from the dark background. The outdoor venues (frames 2 and 4) use flat overcast light that leaves the fighters and props low in contrast.

The fighters cast almost no readable shadows. Grounding comes from the flat circular floor pads under each fighter. Only faint contact darkening appears under Kenji in frame 1. The braziers, statues and throne show no cast shadows on the floor.

The glossy arena floor in frames 1 and 3 reflects the gold ring lines and props, and the dragon statues and crown pick up metallic highlights. The outdoor floors and the castle are fully matte with no environment response.

The crowd is placeholder black silhouette discs with white square dots. The pagoda in frame 4 renders semi-transparent and ghosted pink. Frame 4 puts pine and palm trees in the same scene. Frame 2 mixes a cartoon hand-painted castle with realistic fighters. Both outdoor scenes end in a flat grey sky backdrop.
There is no haze, volumetric spotlight cone or depth fog in any frame. The only effects are a few ember specks in frame 1 and floating white spheres in frame 4 that read as artifacts.

Kenji's gi and skin look plastic and uniformly shaded. Mara's leather has little specular variation. The throne leather and gold trim are the strongest materials. The castle stone in frame 2 is painted-texture stylized and does not match the PBR props.
The throne, crown, dragon statues and braziers carry good detail. The fighter faces are crude, with flat features. Asset styles are inconsistent across venues.

In frames 2 to 4 the fighters sit at the far left and right edges with a large empty centre, so the pair reads small against a busy symmetric background. Frame 1 is broken: Kenji fills the left foreground while Mara is cropped at the top of the frame, floating above the throne area.
A side-on framing at a moderate FOV is held in frames 2 to 4. In frame 1 the camera is pushed in and the opponent is out of place vertically, which suggests a follow or positioning failure.
Frame 2 has a heavy dark vignette over a washed-out, low-contrast tone map. The arena frames crush the mid-dark reds. Bloom is mild and does not support the gold accents.

Both fighters hold nearly identical idle guard poses in all four frames. The poses are stiff, with little weight shift. In frame 1 the opponent appears airborne or misplaced rather than in a grounded stance.

Frame 1 shows a clean fighting-game HUD: name plates, gold health bars, super meters, a round 1 clock at 60, and a control legend strip. The super meter labels are tiny, and the web nav bar intrudes on the play view.
